Wang Xin is a 30-year-old Taobao store owner in Chengdu. After giving birth to her first child two years
ago, Ms. Wang gains a lot of extra weight and finds her body shape completely different. She is annoyed
with that as she cannot fit in her favorite clothes before giving birth, and she is not confident with her
shape when hanging out with her friends.
Ms. Wang learned about group class in a specialty fitness gym from her friends. She loves the motivating
atmosphere here, which wont make her feel embarrassed with her shape. She especially enjoys the
cycling class and excited about the outcomes
she has lost 5 kg after two months of exercise.
Ms. Li is a housewife in her early 50s, living in Beijing with her family. She has been suffering from some
minor health problems, including chronic disease and back pain. Her 22-year-old daughter is a workout
enthusiast and strongly recommended her to do some exercises. Ms. Li tried several online fitness Apps
home but found she could not motivate herself to work out regularly.
Recently Ms. Li's daughter brought her to a specialty fitness gym and tried a yoga group class. She felt
great about this new as she could follow the coach and the vibe is motivating However, Ms. Li is
not sure whether she will come regularly and spend more money on group classes.
Willingness to pay: low to medium
Alexa is a 25-year-old interior designer based in Shanghai. Following a life philosophy of pursuing
happiness, she wants her workout to be fun and exciting. As a young girl enjoys music and dancing, Alexa
loves Zumba and Jazz. However, she decided to leave the traditional gym near her home since the quality
of dancing classes was not good and the fellow dancers are not cool enough.
Inspired by Red (Xiaohongshu), Alexa started to explore specialty fitness gyms and she was obsessed
with it from her first class. She enjoys dancing with a group of energetic young people and interacting with
them after class. She has already become friends with several classmates.
